description: Bootstrap carousel.js v3.3.7 implementation defining the Carousel class and plugin API, managing carousel behavior such as cycling, sliding, and event handling.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: Class managing Bootstrap carousel component, including methods for cycling, sliding, pausing, and event handling.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for carousel navigation.

methods.name: cycle
methods.description: Starts or resumes automatic cycling of carousel items.

methods.name: getItemIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a given carousel item.

methods.name: getItemForDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the next or previous item based on direction.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Navigates to a specific carousel item by position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next carousel item.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous carousel item.

methods.name: slide
methods.description: Performs the slide transition to the next or previous item.
